title: Pure Live☆Twin
summary: Ki-sikil and Lil-la in both their forms, the Live☆Twin streamers and the Evil★Twin Links they become, with generic staples. The page treats the two as one deck, and the Live☆Twin cards only search and summon for Evil★Twin, so both are counted as the archetype here. Live☆Twin Ki-sikil and Lil-la each summon the other from the Deck when they're your only monster, and the pair Link into Evil★Twin Ki-sikil or Evil★Twin Lil-la, which draw or destroy a card and bring the partner back from the GY on either turn. Secret Password searches the Spells and Traps, and Live☆Twin Home summons a twin from the Deck at Quick-Play speed. The 2025 cards lead. Live☆Twin Lil-la Sweet discards itself to negate a response to a Live☆Twin effect and comes back from the GY. Evil★Twin Ki-sikil Deal is a Link-1 that mills a Lil-la and draws whenever the opponent responds.
